datafield.subfield: selected poems 1935-1942 that present the poet's pacifist position through the Second World War
William Everson ; with an introduction by the author & interview ; illustrations by Tom Killion ; edited by Les Ferriss
"Designed, printed and bound by Richard Bigus of Labyrinth Editions"--Colophon.

"Poems are handset in 18-point Centaur type (designed by Bruce Rogers and based on the roman letters used by Nicolas Jenson in 1470) with Arrighi Italic; the initials and titling are Castellar; the text is set in 12-pont Centaur monotype with Arrighi; the book was printed on a Vandercook proofing press. The illustrations were printed from the original linoleum blocks carved by artist Tom Killion."--Colophon.

"The text paper for the Roman numeraled copies I-L is Japanese handmade Hosho professional and Suzuki; the text paper for the numbered copies 51-250 is Japanese Masa and Suzuki. Imago Papermill made the broad sheet papers used in the portfolio of the roman numeraled edition. All copies are signed by the poet and artist. The decorative cover sheets were made by the printer."--Colophon.
